title: Approval of a one (1)-year Lease with Signature Flight Support LLC: With two (2) six-month renewal options, covering use of aviation land located at Van Nuys Airport for commercial hangar operations,
text:
[REGULAR ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Regular Items 11 - 16]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of a one (1)-year Lease with Signature Flight Support LLC: With two (2) six-month renewal options, covering use of aviation land located at Van Nuys Airport for commercial hangar operations, aircraft storage, and maintenance, for estimated minimum revenue of $3,280,000 over the potential two (2)-year term (Jean-Pierre Tabet)
summary: One-year lease with Signature Flight Support LLC for aviation land at Van Nuys Airport for commercial hangar operations, aircraft storage and maintenance, with estimated minimum revenue of $3,280,000 over the potential two-year term.
